scope: Complete origin/Main...HEAD PR diff, with additional execution tests reviewed after the full regression.

findings.finding: Existing connection regression proved native restoration but did not execute all five restored consumers. Broader inference suites did not close this gap.
findings.resolution: Add ten actual Chrome/ComfyUI execution cases with two output expectations per consumer, Bridge mode continuation, native reload, fixed widget expectations and independent literal outputs.

quality_assessment: Production fallback remains four local expressions; four unused callback captures were already removed. No new product dependencies or abstraction layer.
Reuse shared browser, export and widget observation helpers; use standard Playwright response expectations for the Bridge continuation that ordinary run() cannot handle.
Tests assert queue outputs, visible text, downstream modes and saved values; caches are disabled and recorded histories confirm consumers were not cached.
Baseline fails with the original undefined.type exception. Two behavior mutations fail on concrete wrong output assertions.
No production code, widget definitions or trusted catalog fixtures changed in the execution follow-up.
